function_ir.summary: Loads mesh/resource data into a freshly allocated 52-byte node by name, then inserts it into a linked list owned by the caller. If force-insert is requested or the list is empty the node is appended to the tail; otherwise the list is walked by name string and, on a match, the new node is discarded and the existing node returned. Returns 0 on insert, -2 on duplicate found, -1 on load failure.

If sub_5508A0(node, a3) returns non-zero the mesh load failed and the failure path is taken.

On load failure, invoke EmptyStub_7470 on the node then FreeWrapper_7bcf to release its memory, null *a2, and return -1.
Return -1 when the mesh load failed (out-parameter set to null).
Insert path is taken when the low bit of flag a4 is set (force insert) or when the list head at this+0x118 is null.
Append operation: if the head at this+0x118 is non-null, walk next pointers at node+0x30 to the tail and link the new node there; otherwise set this+0x118 to the new node.
Link the new node: node[11] (previous) = prior tail, node[12] (next) = 0, and output the new node via *a2; the function returns 0 on success.
Return 0 when the node was inserted into the list.

Deduplication walk: compare the node name string (node+28) with strcmp, advancing through next pointers at node+48 until a name match or the end of the list; hitting the end falls through to the append path.
On a name match, call CallWrapperReturning0, free the newly allocated duplicate via EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf, output the existing node via *a2, and return -2.
Return -2 when a duplicate-name node already existed (the existing node is reused).
